info.title: Sentworth API
info.summary: Hand posts to a person's social accounts from a program.
info.description: Hand in, look up, change and cancel posts on the accounts a person connected to Sentworth. Make a key in Assistants and programs, under Keys, and send it as "Authorization: Bearer sw_live_…" (or in an x-api-key header). Every error answers with { "code", "message", "details" }; the message says in words what to do. Limits: 10 asks a second per key, 1,000 writes and 20,000 reads a day per key, and 100 posts in 5 minutes and 400 an hour per person across every way of posting. Answers carry RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset (the second), and RateLimit-Day-* (today's ceiling); a 429 carries Retry-After.

bearer.description: A key made in Assistants and programs, under Keys, starting sw_live_

get.description: The person's connected accounts with their ids, their time zone and the time now, what is left today on X and TikTok, and which accounts the person approves posts to first (waits_for_yes, off unless they turned it on). Call it first.

post.description: Hands in a post, a thread, or a draft to accounts named by id, network or group. Say when with exactly one of time, next_usual_time, now or draft. Send a reference so a retry makes one post.

get.description: Posts newest first, with filters (state, network, made by, words) and a date range.
One post: its state, each account's result in words, and any link. Never hand over again a post that says do_not_hand_over_again.

delete.description: Cancels any of the person's posts while it has not gone out, the ones they wrote themselves included.

patch.description: Changes any of the person's posts while it has not gone out, the ones they wrote themselves included. "now" sends it at once.

post.summary: Get a link for a file
post.description: A drop page for the person to put a picture or video on (up to 500 MB, lasts 24 hours). Asking again returns the same link and what was dropped, as media ids to use in create_post.

get.description: The limits and rules of one network: lengths, files, replies, gaps and daily posts. Read them before handing in.
